semantic.justification: AQF9AG ports the numeric/logical result cases and terminal overflow/failure outputs from ImpSvNumberInputScan::IsNumberFormat as an implementation fragment over the same actual scanner state. It joins numeric fragments by nThousand/nDecPos, converts percentages and simple/mixed fractions, preserves sign multiplication and uses the existing RTL owner for scientific conversion. OutOfRange returns Text with a positive bound before input sign application, preserving CALC-300. StringToDouble binds correctly rounded binary64 conversion only for the source-validated unsigned fixed-decimal fragments within the full scanner input limit; it is not a text-recognition API. GetTimeRef uses this same source helper for its fractional-second fragment. The result fragment requires the source category/count checks and numeric category dispatch to have succeeded. It is not yet connected to a public IsNumberFormat or CSV auto-input; remaining validation, calendar date conversion and formatter format selection are unported. Tests use the actual input scanner classifications and RTL conversion, not a synthetic workbook or compiled native differential oracle. The same fragment now includes source post-classification signed-year/BCE handling, unclosed-parenthesis rejection, category-specific numeric-part count checks, matched-format grouping reconciliation and date-pattern acceptance gates. It invokes the existing source scanner helpers on the real owner. Public input orchestration and actual calendar conversion remain pending.
